page.title: Journal
page.purpose: Give the minter the complete, append-only record of the economy, including who caused each event and how they were verified.

priorities.statement: Every event is present and nothing has been compacted away.
Actor provenance — who caused this and whether they were verified — is visible per event.
priorities.notes: This is what distinguishes an agent-initiated grant from an operator-initiated one after the fact.

priorities.statement: A correction and the event it corrects are visibly linked, and neither is hidden.
The journal offers no destructive action, because none exists.
priorities.notes: The absence is the point; a reader should be able to see that history cannot be edited here.

states.description: Only part of the range loaded; the gap is stated rather than implied.
Showing a cached page of events after a failed refresh, labelled as such.

elements.name: Events
elements.description: Every journal event with kind, amount, holder, actor and time.

elements.name: Verification
elements.description: Whether the acting identity was verified, unverified, or absent.

elements.name: Correction
elements.description: A compensating event shown linked to its original.

elements.name: Export
elements.description: Downloads the journal for a period.

claims.statement: Every event row carries a verification status, including when that status is unverified.
No edit or delete affordance exists anywhere on this page.
claims.rationale: Structural expression of OT-P0-010: the repository has no update or delete, and the UI must not imply otherwise.

claims.statement: A compensating event is rendered linked to the event it corrects, and both remain visible.
The partial state states which range failed to load rather than presenting an incomplete list as complete.
The journal offers filtering by holder, token type and event kind.
